reviewed.suggested_tightening: Add the probable-cause and stationhouse-custody limits to the frontmatter holding.

defect.evidence_quote: Tests for familial matches are also prohibited.

defect.proposed_fix: Remove from Investigative Genetic Genealogy or relabel as a limited background/contrast citation only if the IGG home page expressly defines that use.

reasons: Investigative genetic genealogy is not shown in the disclosed opinion text or lake holding.

residual_risks: The IGG home-page criteria were not disclosed, so the editorial claim of nearest DNA anchor cannot be verified from the required evidence universe.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Use a non-key contrast label tied to CODIS/arrestee DNA, not investigative genetic genealogy.

defect.evidence_quote: do not have a direct bearing

defect.proposed_fix: Change role to something like: Key — administrative booking / diminished-privacy DNA search; contrast to special-needs doctrine.

residual_risks: The combined home title includes Administrative Searches, so the placement can stand if the role is narrowed away from direct special-needs treatment.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Make the home-role specific to administrative booking searches.
